pass_a_gloss: And together also be reminded of the one who prayed in spirit about children of witnesses, left down through their love toward God, and who said: keep safe the sons of the ones made to die. And only know that not the children of the flesh, these are children of God, and that, as it is said to those out of Abraham's seed both I know that you are Abraham's seed, and if you were Abraham's children you were doing Abraham's works, thus also to your children it will be said: I know that you are seed of Ambrose, and: if you are children of Ambrose, you do Ambrose's works. And maybe they will do them, you helping them more after such an exit than if you stayed beside them. For at that time you will both love them more knowingly and more wisely pray about them, if you grasp that they are children of yours and not only seed. Hold up and down the mouth now this: the one fond of son or daughter over me is not worth me; and this: the one having found his soul will lose it, and the one having lost his soul on my account will find it.
pass_b_english: At the same time, remember also the one who prayed in the Spirit about the children of martyrs, left behind because of their love for God, and said: “Preserve the sons of those who have been put to death” (Psalm 79:11). Only know that “it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God” (Romans 9:8); and that, just as it is said to those of the seed of Abraham, “I know that you are the seed of Abraham” (John 8:37), and “If you were children of Abraham, you would be doing the works of Abraham” (John 8:39), so it will also be said to your children: I know that you are the seed of Ambrose; and: if you are children of Ambrose, you do the works of Ambrose.

And perhaps they will do them, since you will benefit them more after such a departure than if you stayed with them. For then you will love them with more knowledge and pray for them with more understanding, if [you learn] that they are your children and not only your seed. Keep this on your lips now: “Whoever loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me” (Matthew 10:37), and this: “Whoever finds his soul will lose it, and whoever loses his soul for my sake will find it” (Matthew 10:39).

choices.choice: 2026-11-11: retranslated in full from Koetschau (GCS 2, ch. 38); the old English was a digest. It invented 'your seed shall be reckoned though slain with you' and 'loving Christ more, you gain them too', added Matthew 10:37a and 10:38, and dropped the Abraham and Ambrose seed comparison and the point that Ambrose's departure may help his children more.
Read ὅτε as ὅτι, od as οὐ, 880 as a page number, τέ τε as τό τε (apparatus: M τό, τε), Eore as ἐστε, Aßpaau as Ἀβραάμ, ἥτε as ἦτε, 6 «φιλῶν as ὁ φιλῶν.
